payScales.source: Illustrative placeholder loontabel shape. The ABU CAO applies the inlenersbeloning (WAADI art. 8) -- the uitzendkracht is paid per the inlener's own comparable-function loonschaal -- rather than a single ABU-wide loontabel, so these fase-keyed figures are stand-ins pending confirmation against the official CAO-tekst and are NOT the ABU/NBBU loontabel.
payScales.checkAgainst: Official CAO voor Uitzendkrachten (ABU) beloningsartikelen and the applicable inlener loonschaal (abu.nl/cao)

allowances.source: Illustrative placeholder allowance shape -- ABU toeslagen (ploegentoeslag, onregelmatigheidstoeslag) follow the inlenersbeloning of the inlener, not a fixed ABU rate; pending confirmation against the official CAO-tekst.
allowances.checkAgainst: Official CAO voor Uitzendkrachten (ABU) toeslagenartikelen via the inlenersbeloning (abu.nl/cao)

leaveEntitlement.source: Illustrative placeholder leave entitlement pending confirmation against the official ABU CAO-tekst; ABU verlof follows the inlenersbeloning where the inlener grants more.

workingTime.source: Illustrative placeholder full-time working week pending confirmation against the official ABU CAO-tekst. Display-only -- not read by any CaoRegistry resolver.

overtime.source: Illustrative overwerktoeslag percentages (Uitzend (ABU)) pending confirmation against the official CAO-tekst — NOT transcribed from the primary document. Placeholder, so CaoRegistry::overtimeToeslagPercentages() resolves to null and no overtime uplift is derived from this CAO until the figures are confirmed.
overtime.checkAgainst: abu.nl CAO voor Uitzendkrachten, artikel toeslagen
